topHook: Delta's biggest payer isn't a passenger

scenes.vo: [flat, confident] American Express paid Delta eight point two billion dollars last year.
scenes.label: paid by Amex to Delta, 2025

scenes.vo: That's more than Delta's entire pre-tax profit.
scenes.label: Amex payments

scenes.vo: [lowered, curious] So what is Amex actually buying?
Miles. Every swipe on a Delta card earns SkyMiles, and Amex pays Delta for them.
scenes.label: SWIPE = MILES = $

scenes.vo: That's about thirteen percent of all Delta's revenue.
scenes.label: of Delta's revenue, 2025

scenes.vo: And Delta wants ten billion a year.
scenes.label: Delta's goal from Amex

scenes.vo: [calm, sure] The seat is what you see.
[quiet, knowing] The card is what pays.
